title: Conformal Privacy Auditing: Calibrated Re-identification Attacks with Statistical Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2609.21340v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Empirical identity leakage from released text is increasingly driven by attackers that combine large language models (LLMs) with auxiliary knowledge to link documents to individuals. Existing audits typically report success rates for specific attack pipelines but lack finite-sample statistical guarantees, while training-time protections such as differential privacy are difficult to translate into release-time decisions for individual natural-language documents. We introduce Conformal Privacy Auditing(CPA), a distribution-free calibration framework that provides a statistical certificate of re-identification risk for each released document against LLM-empowered adversaries. CPA outputs a conformal ambiguity set of candidate identities that is guaranteed to contain the true identity with user-chosen confidence under exchangeability, together with an interpretable leakage proxy derived from set size. translated_title: 共形隐私审计：具有统计保证的校准重识别攻击
translated_abstract: 摘要：已发布文本中的经验性身份泄露日益由攻击者驱动，这些攻击者将大语言模型（LLM）与辅助知识相结合，将文档与个人关联起来。现有的审计方法通常只报告特定攻击流程的成功率，但缺乏有限样本的统计保证，而差分隐私等训练时保护措施又难以转化为针对单个自然语言文档的发布时决策。我们提出了共形隐私审计（CPA），这是一个无分布假设的校准框架，可为每个已发布文档提供针对LLM赋能攻击者的重识别风险的统计证书。CPA输出一个候选身份的共形歧义集，在可交换性假设下，该集合保证以用户选择的置信度包含真实身份，同时还提供了一个由集合大小导出的可解释泄露代理指标。CPA同时支持logit访问和基于采样的攻击……
tldr: 提出共形隐私审计（CPA）框架，通过共形校准为已发布文档提供针对LLM赋能攻击者的重识别风险统计证书，输出在给定置信度下保证包含真实身份的候选身份集合及其可解释的泄露代理指标。
en_tdlr: Proposes Conformal Privacy Auditing (CPA), a distribution-free calibration framework that provides finite-sample statistical certificates of re-identification risk for released documents against LLM-empowered adversaries, by outputting conformal ambiguity sets guaranteed to contain the true identity at a user-chosen confidence level.
